CRIME REPORT: Battery and false imprisonment reported at University Park Apartments

Naomi Johnson, Reporter
September 28, 2026
Graphic by Jaya Roberts and Claire Geriak
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:29
Instaread

Sunday, Sept. 20

An unknown suspect reportedly stole a secured bicycle from building 16 of the University Park Apartments between 4 p.m. and 7 p.m.

 

Monday, Sept. 21

These crime logs were reported on Sept. 21; the dates of the actual crimes are included if needed for clarity.

An unknown suspect reportedly stole an electric scooter from Shake Smart at the University Student Union at 4:33 p.m. The incident was captured by the campus CCTV system.

A secured bicycle was reportedly stolen from Building 8 of the University Park Apartments by an unknown suspect between Sept. 19 at 1 p.m. and Sept. 20 at 9:45 a.m.

An electric bike was reportedly stolen from Building 22 of the University Park Apartments by an unknown suspect between 1 a.m. and 1 p.m.

A secured bicycle in Parking Structure B3 was reportedly stolen by an unknown suspect between 9:30 a.m. and 3:50 p.m.

 

Tuesday, Sept. 22

These crime logs were reported on Sept. 22; the dates of the actual crimes are included if needed for clarity.

An unknown suspect stole personal belongings from a locker at the Student Recreation Center between 4 p.m. and 6 p.m.

An unknown suspect reportedly stole an electric scooter from Geronimo’s on Sept. 17.

A bicycle seat was reportedly stolen from Building 19 of the University Park Apartments by an unknown suspect between 5 p.m. Sept. 17 and 6:15 a.m. Sept. 21.

 

Wednesday, Sept. 23

These crime logs were reported on Sept. 23; the dates of the actual crimes are included if needed for clarity.

A suspect held a victim against their will while another suspect assaulted them at Building 4 of the University Park Apartments on Sept. 22.

An unknown suspect used a marker to write graffiti on the door of the men’s restroom in Valera Hall. The date and time of this incident are unknown.

A suspect in Building 18 of the University Park Apartments was contacted by CSUN officers for allegedly possessing a stun gun on campus.

A secured electric scooter was stolen from Goodman Hall by an unknown suspect between 10 a.m. and 11:14 a.m.

 

Thursday, Sept. 24

These crime logs were reported on Sept. 24; the dates of the actual crimes are included if needed for clarity.

An unknown suspect reportedly stole headphones from the Donald Bianchi Planetarium between 4:30 p.m. and 5 p.m. on Sept. 23.

A yellow marker was used to write graffiti in a men’s restroom in Valera Hall by an unknown suspect. The date and time of this incident are unknown.

 

Friday, Sept. 25

There is nothing to report.

 

Saturday, Sept. 26

There is nothing to report.
